Trump’s masked goons are an embarrassment to real law enforcement officials. This Police Week, I want to thank those who pick up the pieces.

Video

This Police Week, I’m pleased to announce my bipartisan Promoting Police Leadership Act has advanced out of committee.

RIers can be very proud of our law enforcement officers who do an exceptional job keeping our communities safe, often in uncertain and dangerous circumstances.

Not much mercury likely where the creepy fossil-fuel billionaires live... they’re cool taking the profits and poisoning other people's kids.
nytimes.com/2026/05/11/clima…

A good summary of Trump’s gilded cesspool of grift and corruption (which by the way likely includes the Billionaire Boys Club wheeler-dealer road trip to China — we’ll see).
theguardian.com/commentisfre…

Has to be Trump/Russia. Something’s up. Maybe Epstein stuff.
nytimes.com/2026/05/12/world…

Our oversight is constitutional — and needs to be protected.

Video

On the Billionaire Boys Trip to China, what chance any of them think about reducing your cost of living, versus wheeler-dealing for themselves?

We know where Trump is: he “doesn’t think about Americans’ financial situation,” busy with billion-dollar ballroom and grifting.

And we’re fifteen years too late to the dark money corruption fight, and twenty-five years too late to the Court capture fight, and thirty-five years too late to the climate denial fraud fight.  But other than that, we’re doing great.  
thenation.com/article/politi…
Trump is a full-on fossil fuel stooge, so neither Trump nor fossil fuel can be trusted. This is another fossil-fuel giveaway in disguise.
If $100/bbl holds, EXCESS profits will be around 1/4 trillion this year. Big Oil COULD lower costs now and chooses not to.
What are chances consumers benefit? Near zero. Industry is sitting on EXCESS profits of $23 billion in one month.
